scope: Read-only HTTP/browser/source checks, plus already-authorized disposable local test accounts and role bindings. No plugin source, installed JAR, permanent role, or site SEO setting changed.

seo.sourceCheck: Installed SEO Tools settings expose one global canonical_link.enabled switch. Its redirection filter matches request path, not query parameters, so built-in redirects cannot normalize page/p conditionally.
seo.result: Existing mismatch reproduced. Plugin canonical remains enabled and theme-only experimental override remains disabled.

bangumi.browser: GET /bangumis displayed a total count of 25, title, and one canonical; no visible 500
bangumi.result: Previous Bilibili TLS-timeout 500 was not reproduced; failure handling remains unverified.

equipment.backendLog: Exactly three PageRequestImpl WARN lines: Page size must not be greater than 1000, reset to 1000
equipment.result: Warning reproduced on a cache-miss request; the theme receives plugin-provided data after the plugin router calls groupBy().

passkey.loginMethodPage: GET /login?method=passkey returned 200; real browser displayed the Passkey button without horizontal overflow
passkey.normalRoleUi: Disposable post-contributor user with verified test email logged in; GET current-user returned 200; /uc/profile?tab=passkey displayed 加载失败 and 重试
passkey.explicitRoleUi: Binding plugin-passkey-role-template-authenticated to the same disposable user and immediately reopening the tab still displayed 加载失败; effective permission propagation after binding was not confirmed
passkey.rawCredentialGet: A browser fetch in an authenticated disposable session returned 403; this does not by itself identify the UI request status or prove the role aggregate failed
passkey.roleSource: Installed role.yaml labels plugin-passkey-role-template-authenticated with aggregate-to-authenticated=true and includes GET /apis/api.passkey.halo.run/v1alpha1/credentials
passkey.cleanup: All disposable users and role bindings created in this follow-up were deleted; final list queries found zero names with the test prefixes. No personal Passkey credential was accessed, created, or deleted.
passkey.limitations: WebAuthn registration, authentication, deletion, and a fully propagated role-rebind flow were not tested. Some preliminary login attempts were invalidated by browser autofill or a saved /logout target; they are excluded from the permission conclusion.
